dedupe_keys.name: ethiopian disaster risk management commission early warning bulletins alerts and hotspot maps

description: The Ethiopian Disaster Risk Management Commission runs a disaster risk management knowledge base and exchange platform. Its early warning and response section publishes weekly Amharic situation updates, fortnightly bulletins and monthly English and Amharic bulletins; alerts for drought, floods and other hazards; hot-spot woreda classifications; drought, flood and emergency contingency and response plans; humanitarian response plans and appeals; nutrition assessment and survey reports; seasonal forecast and weather and climate impact advisories with GeoNetCast and LEAP outputs; and relief dispatch plans. The GIS and maps section offers seasonal thematic maps for the Belg and Meher seasons, vulnerability maps, drought and flood hotspot maps, and rainfall and NDVI environmental condition indicators, and the document repository holds woreda disaster risk profiles, guidelines, manuals and policies. The projects page describes the national incident management system, the shock-responsive safety net and LEAP, the government's food security early warning tool that converts satellite and ground agro-meteorological data into production estimates. Access is free online; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: most products are bulletins and PDF maps, not data tables, and some content needs a login. Coverage is Ethiopia. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response analysis of drought and floods for roads, water supply and other rural infrastructure; related records are the BNPB InaRISK portal and the Mexico Atlas Nacional de Riesgos.
